phase_name: Throwaway-Gate Fixture Proof in Both Suites

objectives.description: Both suites build a fixture store via gate_store_fixture_build
Suite A fixture cases 35-39 (max, accept, refuse, G1, real-registry-untouched)
Suite B fixture case (s), reusing noflag_header_set_check
Factor comparison into reusable functions (ids_match_check, noflag_header_set_check)
Header notes on the durable acceptance-bar proof

approaches_tried.approach: Suite A's case36/37 initially passed $WORKDIR/fixture-store as verify-deploy.sh's TARGET argument
approaches_tried.reason: verify-deploy.sh refuses any TARGET without an existing deployed .claude/ tree before it reaches gate dispatch at all; gate_store_fixture_build does not create one (by design -- it only builds the agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/ mirror). Fixed by passing $REPO_ROOT as TARGET instead, matching how Phase 1's own manual verification invoked the fixture's verify-deploy.sh; --only-gate <id> for the throwaway gate needs only the fixture's own self-relative-resolved verify-deploy.sh/lib/data, not TARGET itself, to carry the fixture shape.

deviations.reason: The plan's prose assumed the real registry's live max was 26 (so the fixture's extra id would be 27). By Phase 6, the live max had already moved to 27 (a sibling task registered a real gate during Phase 2). Used the derived $((REGISTRY_MAX + 1)) = 28 instead of the bare literal 27, which is both correct and exactly the point of this task.
